_doc.what: MAIN sum trim (dB) applied to the summed output (MAIN+DRUMS) so it stays at -19.0 LUFS-S; keyed by dialect and active-MAIN-lane set
_doc.model: sum = powersum(active lane st_target_lufs + DRUMS default voices) - calibration_db[class(active set)]; class = D + B(bass) + O(stab/pluck/hits/pad) + V(vox); STAB+PLUCK both on -> each -3 dB
_doc.trim_rule: trim_db = model_sum(dialect default MAIN lanes) - model_sum(active set)  (0 dB at the default set, which MIX_SPEC tunes to -19.0 with the render-measured output_trim_db). trim_abs_db and default_model_residual_db are INFORMATIONAL ONLY and must NEVER be applied by the engine
_doc.apply_at: MAIN output stage after the per-dialect output_trim_db (MIX_SPEC §2.1.6); not a user parameter

ramp.restart: a toggle mid-ramp starts a new ramp from the current value

_doc.lookup: by_mask (dialect x active-lane bitmask, 64 entries) is normative because the spread within a lane count reaches 1.24 dB (> the 0.5 LU tolerance); by_count is the summary (median, min, max, max deviation)
